dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit scalloped perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from dark-valued exterior pixels to lighter interior regions. Prominent closed-loop rings are concentrated on the upper-left and central dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli and towards the posterior-lateral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-left flank form a scalene triangle. A secondary chain of five smaller centroids forms an approximately linear alignment along the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several orange-brown linear features are visible on the far-left anterior edge, appearing as superficial temporal marks or adhered environmental debris.
